research.name: ol3Echarts
research.note: Overlays Apache ECharts series such as migration lines and scatter points on an OpenLayers map, keeping view and coordinates in sync.

effects: ECharts chart layer overlaid on an OpenLayers map in map coordinates
curved migration routes with plane markers between cities on a dark basemap
dense glowing point cloud of check-in data lighting up a country map
